body:
## Summary

Summary-local `pick(..i)` preserves forwarded promises. `across()` expands names over the complete column/function vectors and shares resolved names between planning and execution; uncertain local bindings retain runtime lookup.

```text
pick(..i) -> caller promise -> local selection
across() -> full naming vectors -> resolved names -> summaries and shares
```

Closes #1182. Closes #1183.

## Evidence

- **Before:** `pick(..1)` rejected column `..1`; two-column dtplyr output used `y_1` instead of `y_2`, and valid vector templates/share-source names were refused.
  **After:** public ordinary comparisons preserve `x_1 = 6`, `y_2 = 18`, valid shares, output order and ordinary naming evaluation counts. Coverage includes first/later/nested dots, multiple columns/functions, preceded summaries, source/output names, caller effects and supported local/lazy paths.
- [Verification for 480033fe](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1192#issuecomment-6610335168): full source-tarball check passed; 212 files, PASS 180819, FAIL/WARN/SKIP 0, ERROR/WARNING/NOTE 0. Timing proposal accepted unchanged after earlier measured registrations.
- [Standards and Spec review](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1192#issuecomment-6616050778): final rounds have 0 findings on each axis; prior findings and fixes are recorded there.
- **CI follow-up:** the existing PostgreSQL alias step was absent from the executable contract. `98d5e442` registers it and adds a deletion-refusal fixture. [Source verification](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/pull/1192#issuecomment-6616049347) and all three failing-step commands pass locally; GitHub CI has restarted and is queued.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the earlier forwarding and naming behavior.

**Blast Radius:** summaries

Affects local pick selection and ordinary/share across naming. Static share-source provenance remains conservative when caller code prevents a safe name proof.
title: Fix summary-local pick forwarding and vectorized across names
